whats_new:
* Hierarchical Codebase Analysis Engine: Automatically mirrors folder structure in .code-analysis/ with minute details (exports, types, hooks, IPC channels) saving ~888,000+ AI context tokens.
* Windows Taskbar Live Previews: Hovering over sidebar navigation items renders real-time thumbnail previews simulating native Windows taskbar popovers.
* Islamic Welcome Screen & Arabic Typography: Centered Arabic calligraphy (أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا) with kinetic typography wave animations and docked preloader without redundant branding.
* Animated Arabic Greeting in Email Studio: Embedded ONTO wave calligraphy greeting banner for luxury client announcements.
* Multi-Folder Batch Queue & Reordering: Support for rendering N batches with dynamic priority reordering and automated photo transfer.
release_notes: UniDesk Studio v26.11.0 is a major milestone release introducing an enterprise-grade hierarchical codebase token caching engine, native Windows taskbar-style live page previews, an authentic Islamic welcome screen with kinetic Arabic typography, multi-folder batch rendering reordering, and critical stability fixes preventing Task Tracker background freezes.
bugs_fixed:
* Resolved Task Tracker Freeze: Eliminated aggressive synchronous drive root scanning across floppy/card-reader drives (A: and B:), implemented throttled background sentinel and 8-second cached scan result.
* Fixed Settings Software Updates: Removed deprecated "Preview Welcome Screen" button, added real-time feedback and toast notifications for updates and email subscriptions.
* Fixed GitHub README Animated Banner: Re-engineered resources/banner.svg using 100% native SVG elements and keyframes, bypassing GitHub Camo's foreignObject sanitization filter.
* Audio Assignment Pool Persistence: Prevented audio settings from resetting back to defaults across render cycles.
improvements:
* Title Adder UI Polish: Cleaned batch cards, balanced spacing, refined toggle switches, and elevated action buttons.
* Token Cache Integration: Instantaneous SHA-256 incremental checks preventing redundant re-analysis across sessions.
* Light & Dark Mode Contrast Tuning: Warm architectural linen light mode and high-contrast obsidian dark mode for zero eye strain.

whats_new:
• Linux & Windows Cross-Platform Release Studio: Complete automated release pipeline engine (make_exe_cross.py) supporting compilation across both Windows and Linux, generating production Windows executables (.exe), NSIS installers, and Linux packages (.AppImage / .deb).
• Modern 4-Tab CustomTkinter Studio UI: Redesigned the developer compilation hub with a clean Segmented Architecture (Pipeline & Console, Release Notes, Email Broadcast, Settings & Diagnostics), custom taskbar branding, Segoe UI typography, and responsive auto-centering layout.
• Live Obsidian Build Console: Real-time high-contrast terminal console with syntax highlighting, streaming live compilation logs for npm and makensis, clipboard export, and auto-scrolling execution tracking.
• Interactive Toolchain Diagnostics with Dynamic Re-Scan: Added real-time pre-flight inspection for Node.js, NPM, Git, NSIS (makensis), Inno Setup (ISCC), Wine, and GitHub authentication, with an on-demand Re-scan button to refresh tool status instantly.
• Smart Release Notes & Markdown Composer: Elevated 2×2 changelog editor with auto-bullet continuation (Enter key detection), one-click Auto-Compile Changelog synthesizer, bullet point normalizer, and in-app GitHub Markdown previewer.
release_notes:
• Linux & Windows Cross-Platform Release Engine (make_exe_cross.py)
• Modern 4-Tab CustomTkinter Studio UI with Real-Time Obsidian Terminal
• Fixed Persistent False-Positive Update Prompt on Workstation Startup

• Smart Release Notes Composer with Auto-Bullets & Markdown Preview
• Dedicated Google Sheets Client Email Notification Center

bugs_fixed:
• Fixed Persistent False-Positive Startup Update Prompt: Corrected semver version comparison logic and release tag sanitization on app boot, ensuring the workstation does not prompt users to update when already running the latest release.
• Fixed Missing Makensis Dependency Detection: Resolved environment detection failure where local electron-builder and user-level NSIS binaries were undetected by adding multi-directory fallback resolution (get_makensis_path).
• Fixed IDE Import Squiggly Underlines: Resolved Pylance/Pyright missing-stubs warnings on customtkinter imports by configuring workspace Python interpreter paths and adding type-checking annotations.
• Fixed Release Studio Console Squishing: Eliminated nested-scroll layout conflicts that previously compressed the execution terminal into a tiny 3-line box.
improvements:
• Persistent Docked Action Center: Bottom status dock featuring live target version badges, active pipeline stage counters, pulsing status LED, and seamless auto-tab switching when launching builds.
• Streamlined Email Broadcast Management: Dedicated client communication center with template token formatting ({version}, {app_name}), Google Apps Script client list retrieval, and live browser HTML previews.
• Standalone Studio Compiler: Added compile_studio.bat allowing one-click packaging of make_exe_cross.py into a portable standalone UniDeskStudio.exe with bundled icons.
• One-Click Quick Version Bumpers: Integrated Suggested, + Patch, and + Minor buttons to instantly calculate and populate consecutive semver tags.

whats_new:
• Nikah Ceremony Automation & Mango Group Photo Ripple Placement: Intelligent Nikah ceremony detection in Premiere Pro CEP extensions now seamlessly identifies complex marker naming formats (e.g. 1448-02-29 _01M-01-N- and 1448-02-29 _01M-01-01N-40905764) without false session code shadowing. Features an interactive ceremony range prompt (e.g. 1-4, all) and full multi-track downstream ripple insertion so zero footage is cut.
• Lightning-Fast XML Sequence Locator for Premiere Pro: High-speed multi-tier XML search engine across all CEP extensions resolves sequence XML files in under 1ms via shared recent-project caching, active project folder traversal, and project bin media inspection, completely eliminating tedious manual file browsing.
• Zero-Click Domino Pipeline (Media Encoder ➔ Title Adder ➔ Converter): Hands-free end-to-end rendering and organizing. When Title Adder finishes rendering the video title batch, it automatically chains into Converter to execute Rename & Move on photos and videos without requiring any user clicks.
• Batch Completion Audio Chimes & Native Desktop Notifications: Distinctive 4-tone celebration shimmer chord and Windows native desktop notifications alert editors immediately when long overnight batches complete, even if the app is minimized.
release_notes:
* Nikah Ceremony Automation & Mango Group Photo Multi-Track Ripple Placement
* Lightning-Fast XML Sequence Locator across Premiere Pro CEP Extensions
* Zero-Click Domino Mode: Title Adder Auto-Chaining into Converter Rename & Move
* Native Windows Desktop Notifications & 4-Tone Celebration Shimmer Chime
* EBUSY Lock Suppression & Resilient Debounced Log Tailer
* Root-Level Safar Backup Reconciliation & Archive Vault Stability Upgrades
bugs_fixed:
• Fixed Nikah Marker Prefix Shadowing: Resolved bug where morning session tags (_01M) caused the marker parser to match M (Majlis) instead of N (Nikah).
• Fixed EBUSY / File-Locking Dialogs: Permanently suppressed transient Windows and OneDrive EBUSY error popups during Adobe Media Encoder log tailing with exponential retry backoff and debounced stream reading.
• Fixed Auto-Render Premature Trigger: Title Adder now verifies that all batch videos have completed rendering before auto-starting, preventing single-video premature render triggers.
• Fixed Root-Level Safar Detection in Backup Reconciler: Added support for Safar directories located directly on root drive letters (e.g. D:\1448-08 Mumbai...).
• Fixed Archive Vault Column Resizing: Prevented null reference crashes during rapid header dragging and stabilized live window.api proxy connectivity.
improvements:
• Instant XML Locator Fallback: Pre-focuses the native file picker directly in the project or date directory if manual selection is ever needed.
• Title Adder Predefined Settings Cleanup: Automatic unlinking and post-render purge of temporary .tmp placeholder files from DVD folders.
• Intelligent Audio Mute Rules: Unmuted videos automatically use silence-fill so background music never covers active speaking voices.
• Automated Client Email Announcements: make_exe.py builds branded HTML changelog emails synced with client distribution lists.
